req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The view_cookies handler reads request.cookies, filters ENV_COOKIES when hide_env=True and show_env not in args, then returns jsonify(cookies=cookies). Tests must cover: (1) positive path with one or more cookies present, (2) negative path with no cookies, (3) boundary with exactly one cookie vs zero cookies, (4) multiple cookies, (5) show_env query param behaviour, (6) exact JSON structure including the 'cookies' key. Mutation targets: the 'cookies' key name in jsonify, the hide_env logic, the dict construction, and the 200 status code.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_payload
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing one name=value pair
expected: cookies dict contains exactly the sent cookie
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_single():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_get_cookies_single()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_boundary_zero_vs_one_cookie
actions: Send GET /cookies with no cookies (0 cookies)
Send GET /cookies with exactly one cookie (1 cookie)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_boundary_zero_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['cookies'] == {}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 0

def test_boundary_one_cookie():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'k=v'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['cookies'] == {'k': 'v'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_boundary_zero_cookies()
test_boundary_one_cookie()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_multiple_cookies_returns_all

expected: cookies dict contains all three cookies with exact values

tests.name: test_get_cookies_json_key_is_exactly_cookies_not_cookie
actions: Check that top-level key is 'cookies' not 'cookie' or 'data'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_exact_key_name():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'foo=bar'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'cookie' not in data
    assert 'data' not in data
    assert 'headers' not in data
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'cookies'}

tests.name: test_get_cookies_cookie_value_exact_string_not_mutated
actions: Send GET /cookies with cookie value containing alphanumeric and underscore
expected: Exact cookie value preserved in response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_exact_value_preserved():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'token=abc_XYZ_789'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['cookies']['token'] == 'abc_XYZ_789'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'abc_XYZ_78'
    assert data['cookies']['token'] != 'abc_XYZ_7890'

test_get_cookies_exact_value_preserved()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_state_transition_set_then_list

expected: Cookie appears in listing with correct name and value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_state_set_then_list_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'mykey=myvalue'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'mykey' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['mykey'] == 'myvalue'

tests.name: test_get_cookies_boundary_two_cookies_exact_count
actions: Send GET /cookies with exactly two cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_boundary_two_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'first=one; second=two'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2
    assert data['cookies']['first'] == 'one'
    assert data['cookies']['second'] == 'two'
    assert data['cookies'] == {'first': 'one', 'second': 'two'}
